findings.claim: TestLogger.FromContext returns a new instance via NewTestLogger() instead of the receiver f. Logs written through FromContext(ctx), such as those from LoggerMiddleware, go to a throwaway logger, so tests asserting on the original TestLogger see no calls.

verifier.reason: pkg/plugins/log/fake.go:46-48 has `FromContext` return `NewTestLogger()` rather than `f`, and pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:58 logs via `m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...)`, so those calls would not be recorded on the original TestLogger. No test in the repo currently asserts on a TestLogger passed through that path, and the existing `New()` at fake.go:18-20 behaves the same way, so the effect is latent.

findings.claim: ContextualLoggerMiddleware's QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth and CollectMetrics dereference req.PluginContext with no nil check on req, so a nil request panics. Other middlewares, including LoggerMiddleware, guard against nil requests.

verifier.reason: The unguarded `req.PluginContext` dereferences exist (contextual_logger_middleware.go:40,45,50,55), but a nil request cannot reach them: the only entry point, `Decorator`, returns `errNilRequest` before building the chain (pkg/plugins/manager/client/decorator.go:30,40,53,62). `TracingMiddleware` and `MetricsMiddleware`, which run earlier in the chain, dereference `req` unguarded too (tracing_middleware.go:85, metrics_middleware.go:146), so the 'other middlewares guard' premise is only partly true.

findings.claim: LoggerMiddleware no longer adds pluginId, endpoint, uname, dsName, dsUID and traceID to its 'Plugin Request Completed' log line. It relies on ContextualLoggerMiddleware being earlier in the CreateMiddlewares chain, so reordering or omitting it drops those fields with no error, and this is neither documented nor tested.

verifier.reason: pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go:49-58 now logs only status/duration/eventName/time_before_plugin_request via m.logger.FromContext(ctx), so pluginId/endpoint/uname/dsName/dsUID appear only because ContextualLoggerMiddleware sits before it at pkg/services/pluginsintegration/pluginsintegration.go:160-161; no comment states the ordering requirement and no logger or contextual-logger middleware test exists.
